column3: The Walking Statues of Horning Church
column5: The stone figures of the Four Evangelists atop the church tower mysteriously descend one by one in successive years before returning to their perches. statue

Located in Druid Ridge Cemetery in Maryland, this statue is said to bring misfortune or death to those who meet its gaze at night. Legends claim the eyes of the statue glow red, and it is surrounded by an unsettling aura.
